baseline: Q3R000 exact R027 dimensions, identities and coordinates
groups: 3 tower-distance rank strata by stable identity ties, each split at tower-relative polar pi; groups 0,2,4 north, 1,3,5 south; fixed 6 groups

search_scope.width_interval: [2, actual group minimum cap minus 0.005 m]

rng.mapping: same stable position_key and standard time index and batch across designs; different area maps same uniforms to different finite mirrors; common physical directions; all batches independent within namespace
rng.prefix: nested within batch; only largest n pooled; prefixes diagnostic only

score.obstacles: all 2981 at each time; verified conservative screening

low.purpose: heuristic score; no formal rating; sampled zero condition NA preserved

fine.purpose: full60 candidate comparison, whole-batch JK SE; no final rating

initial_response_experiments: all groups width and height 6.69 except group5 height6.15
adaptive_rule: After initial responses, combine a beneficial area reduction or height change with compensating expansion in other groups; always reevaluate full scene. Perturb at most 3 groups per response step, then joint candidate. Width steps 0.02 or 0.04; height steps 0.05,0.10,0.20,0.25,0.50,1.00; z steps 0.25,0.50,1.00 within approved scope. Halve step near rating boundary, at most twice. Changes use actual group caps, never automatic clipping. Additional coupled candidate can reuse all-group 6.69 as parent. Candidate may be rejected on geometry only with explicit report.
ranking: Preserve immutable old feasible baseline. Search candidates with unresolved totals cannot be rated. Before feasibility prefer reduced power deficit; then prefer q with positive power headroom. Do not infer monotonicity. Pair whole-batch q differences; <3 paired JK SE or <prefix/raw diagnostic change is unresolved, not established improvement. Fine short-list includes best plausible feasible-q candidates and at least one response/control.
freeze_gate: Fine full60 P - max(3*JK_SE_P, absolute half-prefix difference, absolute raw difference) > 60000 and positive q change supported relative to same-stream baseline; if low mode cannot rank or geometry unknown, no freeze. Prefer at least 30 kW additional headroom above this working margin to reduce confirmation failure risk; this is selection policy not extra problem constraint.
confirmation_plan: Freeze separately before results; >=8 independent fresh batches; initial n256 nested128, max512 if registered evidence and remaining budget suffice. Candidate and R027 same new streams for pairing. Hold back confirmation data from any tuning. Work U=max(t7 whole-batch JK halfwidth,prefix change,raw estimator shift)+coordinatewise low-survival bound; actual per-mirror area in power/area auxiliary. Pointwise approximate sampling term, not joint confidence nor physical error guarantee.
low_states: record true zero evidence, sample zeros, conditional undefined and boundary unknown separately. Low-survival threshold100 is managerial screen; full feasible loss-share variation bound for each affected object, weighted by actual area for energy. No deletion, zero-fill or clipping. Search score finite zero capture only heuristic; total energy may be legitimately estimable with undefined conditional component.
stop: Do not use confirmation outcomes to change candidate; if failure save and stop or explicit newly budgeted search with fresh namespace under frozen rules, never seed shopping. No automated Q3B/C expansion. At phase wall cap terminate workers and preserve chunks.
code_binding: Per evaluation binding.json pins all execution dependencies and design SHA; this rules file SHA recorded in each spec. No old accepted source modified.
prior_evidence: old-baseline-group-analysis.json uses old R027 confirmation as search evidence, not as new independent comparative data. Actual old group q is only a response hypothesis, modifications require full reevaluation.
